title: El Árbol de Metepec, VISTA STORIES
comment: arbol-metepec (VISTA): mercado de artesanías de barro en Metepec, Estado de México. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.JAZMIN_ESQUIVEL: Mexican woman from the State of Mexico, clay artisan, 27 years old, light-brown skin, black hair in a high ponytail tied with a red ribbon, a mustard-yellow t-shirt, a denim apron with small paint stains, jeans, white sneakers, her hands empty.
chars.URIEL_SAUCEDO: Mexican man, 36 years old, stocky, light-brown skin, black hair shaved on the sides with a gelled top, a black goatee, a burgundy velvet bomber jacket over a black t-shirt, two gold rings, dark jeans, white sneakers, his hands empty.
chars.AMPARO_VILLALBA: Elegant Mexican matriarch, 70 years old, light skin, silver hair in an elegant low bun, a black shawl over a black dress, a pearl necklace, big gold rings, black low heels, holding dark sunglasses.
chars.RAMIRO_LUNA: Mexican man, 31 years old, thin, brown skin, messy short black hair, light stubble, a grey hoodie, jeans, worn sneakers, small dry clay stains on his hands, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_MERCADOMETEPEC: Artisan market aisle in Metepec, State of Mexico, during the day: small stalls full of colorful painted clay trees of life, clay suns and pottery on wooden shelves, colorful plain paper banners without letters hanging overhead, a stone floor, soft daylight, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
